title: Serpico
tagline: One honest cop. No free sandwiches.
about: An honest New York cop blows the whistle on police corruption.
cue: Serve the mains when Frank turns down the free meal at the deli.
faces: Our store on West 10th, a few doors from the Sixth Precinct.
Steamed soft, hand sliced, piled high, with mustard and a pickle.
Steamed pastrami, Swiss, slaw and Russian dressing on a long roll.
Brisket cured in our own brine, carved to order, with mustard.
Rare top round, sliced thin while you wait. Ask for it lean.
EAT AT THE COUNTER OR TAKE IT HOME
Toasted and spread thick with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers, red onion and fresh dill.
Baked golden, split and spread with brown mustard.
Soft sour cream cake cookie, iced half vanilla, half chocolate.
Rich and dense, a thick slice baked here every morning.
Dark roast steeped overnight in the icebox, vanilla syrup, milk and a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
Syrup, cold milk and seltzer from the siphon.
Hot all day. Tea comes in a glass.
Everybody pays at the register, the boys from the Sixth too. Opera on the radio Saturdays. Dogs wait outside, even the sheepdog.
West 10th St., N.Y. 10014. WAtkins 4-1967. Open 7 to midnight.
